interventions.detail: Used Python 3.9 venv; parl pins grpcio==1.37.0/pyzmq==22.3.0 that have no py3.12 wheels
Overrode parl's protobuf<=3.20.0 pin to protobuf==3.20.3 because paddlepaddle 2.6.2+ needs protobuf>=3.20.2
Installed setuptools<70 because parl imports pkg_resources, which a fresh venv lacks
Pinned numpy<2 and paddlepaddle==2.6.2 for gym 0.26.2 compatibility (np.bool8)
Installed parl from the clone non-editably; the uv editable install did not make parl importable
